components.name: App Rail
components.description: Persistent 68px glass rail for home, pinned tools, search and settings.
components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:68px;padding:12px 10px;background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--color-rail-base,#f7fbff) 62%,transparent);border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(135%);}.ds-brand{width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid rgba(51,144,236,.24);border-radius:13px;background:rgba(51,144,236,.10);color:var(--color-primary-strong,#006dc3);font-family:Nunito,sans-serif;font-weight:800;}.ds-rail-button{width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;background:transparent;color:var(--color-text-secondary,#526273);}.ds-rail-button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.48);color:var(--color-text-primary,#0b1724);}.ds-rail-button:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #fff,0 0 0 3px var(--color-primary-strong,#006dc3);}.ds-active{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-primary,#3390ec) 10%,transparent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-primary,#3390ec) 22%,transparent);color:var(--color-primary-strong,#006dc3);}

narrative.overview: everydaytool is a persistent desktop tool launcher, not a monitoring dashboard. A narrow rail keeps tools within one click; the center carries exactly one active workspace; a tool is instantiated only when opened and is destroyed when closed. Translucent surfaces establish spatial layering, fine rules establish structure, and signal blue marks action, selection and focus. Decoration never creates hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Tools first, status second; the home screen never shows runtime status, versions or category metadata.
One active tool and one runtime; switching away or closing unmounts the component and releases its timers, subscriptions, webviews and tool-level backend sessions.
68px glass rail, 48px workspace bar and a single 16px glass work surface.
Cool glass, pale blue ambient light and 1px translucent edges, without stacked cards or heavy shadows.
Brand blue #3390ec and ink blue #006dc3 are the only accent colors.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Only brand blue carries action, current selection and focus. Everything else emphasizes through scale, space and neutral value.

rules.name: The Neutral Label Rule
rules.body: Tabs, selected rows and active rail labels use neutral primary text, not bright blue small type.

rules.name: The Glass Boundary Rule
rules.body: Glass belongs to surface-to-background boundaries only. Fields, rows, buttons and fills never add backdrop-filter.

rules.name: The Content Is Opaque Rule
rules.body: Text, icons, status dots, progress and switch knobs remain opaque. Transparency belongs to large surfaces.

rules.name: The No Micro Type Rule
rules.body: Production UI never uses 9–10px text. The minimum size is 11px, including table headers, status lines and keycaps.

rules.name: The One Display Size Rule
rules.body: 25px is reserved for the home title. Tool titles are 17px and section titles 16px.

dos: Do keep exactly one primary work surface per tool.
Do move settings, diagnostics, help and installation into an inspector, drawer or sub-route.
Do keep each home tool row to icon, name, one-line description, pin and arrow.
Do expose every tool through Ctrl/Cmd+K and the left rail.
Do verify text contrast on every material and in night glass.
Do confirm only real unfinished work before closing; release everything else immediately.
donts: Don't show runtime status, versions, categories, processes, paths or statistics on the home screen.
Don't stack UiPanel cards as the first viewport of a tool.
Don't retain hidden mounts for every open tab or use cross-tool KeepAlive.
Don't give tools separate accent colors.
Don't use 9–10px text, bright blue small type, colored side stripes or gradient text.
Don't apply backdrop-filter or shadows to every layer.
Don't use a modal for work that belongs inline in the workspace.
